title: Fern’s Glittering Thank‑You Glow

dialogue.speaker: fern
dialogue.text: Look, the wreath glows like sunrise over our meadow!

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Your gratitude shines brighter than any meadow flower!

dialogue.speaker: fern
dialogue.text: Let’s share this bright feeling with all our friends!

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Together we’ll spread gratitude across every gentle hill!

dialogue.speaker: fern
dialogue.text: Our hearts sparkle when we thank each other kindly!

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Thank‑you for sharing gratitude, dear Fern!
